thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: spike of 502/503 from inference-runtime-1 observed across eu-west-1 (approx 2200 errors in last 5m). paging @oncall
Jordan: i'm on it, looking at ksplogs now. can someone check if this correlates with any deploys? :thinking:
Ashley: no deploy in last 30m, CI shows last successful deploy 40m ago. infra autoscaler did a small scale-up ~7m ago.
Samir: i'm seeing most 502s from worker-gpu-2 with repeated \"kv-cache eviction failed\" in the logs. sample:
```\n2026-03-15T09:12:34Z worker-gpu-2 inference-runtime: ERROR kv_cache: eviction failed: context canceled
2026-03-15T09:12:34Z worker-gpu-2 inference-runtime: response 502 backend-unavailable
```
Maria: hmm that fits the autoscale timing. maybe backend instances weren't ready and requests hit a short-lived proxy error.
Jordan: customer impact? which tenants hit this? how noisy is the pager? i see 120 pagers in the last 10m.
Ashley: scrolling tenants now — mostly small bursty PLG users in eu-west. no enterprise SLAs impacted yet. marking P2 for now.
Samir: we should suppress noisy alert signatures for these transient kv-cache evictions while we mitigate. propose: add a regex filter to alert query to ignore \"kv_cache: eviction failed: context canceled\" and raise the 5m threshold from 50 to 90 for the next 30m.
SRE-Lead: agree on suppression but prefer adding a short-lived signature with annotation for follow-up rather than muting permanently. create a signature named \"transient-kv-evict-eu-west\" and roll out to 5% -> 50% -> 100%.
Jordan: working on temporary query tweak now. current alert query:
```\ncount_over_time({env=\"prod\",service=\"inference\"} |= \"response 502\"[5m]) > 50
```
Updated proposal:
```\ncount_over_time({env=\"prod\",service=\"inference\"} |~ \"response 502\" and not (\"kv_cache: eviction failed: context canceled\")[5m]) > 90
```
Ashley: minor nit — the `and not` placement needs to be inside the selector, try:
```\ncount_over_time({env=\"prod\",service=\"inference\"} |~ \"response 502\" and not |~ \"kv_cache: eviction failed\"[5m]) > 90
```
Samir: also adding label-based suppression for autoscaler events: `source!=autoscaler` so we don't mute other real errors.
Maria: i'm spinning up a dashboard panel to monitor kv-cache evictions, proxy 502s, and node readiness. putting a link in ops: https://console.redwood/inbox/d/abcd-evict-triage
deploy-bot: applying alert rule update to staging... terraform plan OK, applying.
deploy-bot: applied alert rule update to staging (rollout id r-482). waiting 60s for evaluation.
Jordan: i've also added a temporary SLO note and slack banner for the PLG channel to reduce duplicate pages.
Ashley: can we add a short-term routing policy: route eu-west 502s to a lower-priority paging group until signature fully validated? if yes, do it.
SRE-Lead: yes, route to `oncall-standby` for now. Jordan, coordinate the routing change and escalate if any enterprise tenant spikes.
Jordan: routing change done. oncall-standby notified. :white_check_mark:
Samir: monitoring — error rate dropping, 502s down 80% in last 12m. paging noise reduced to 3 duplicates.
incident-bot: signature \"transient-kv-evict-eu-west\" created at 1999990180 by Samir. auto-silence 15m initial.
Ashley: rollouts: will do 5% now, 50% in 10m if stable, 100% after postmortem.
deploy-bot: rollouts committed: r-482 -> 5% (1999990220).
Jordan: scheduling follow-up postmortem at 11:00 UTC to decide permanent alert tuning and dashboard retention. action items:
- Samir: formalize signature regex and include example traces (due +2h)
- Maria: save dashboard panel and add to runbook (due +4h)
- Ashley: update alert docs with temporary thresholds and revert plan (due +2h)
SRE-Lead: noted. final note — we should consider longer-term: add readiness/probe gap metrics to pipeline so autoscaler spin-up doesn't create alert storms.
Samir: +1 on probe metrics. adding to backlog.
Jordan: closing pager for now; leave signature in place until postmortem. thanks all. :bow:
